title: Show scoped identity consistently in optimization reports
description:
Ensure the embedded procedure summary and living report use the same sanitized scope identity.

Feature: Scoped optimization identity
  Scenario: A scorecard-scoped portfolio run is displayed
    Given an optimization portfolio procedure has one or more scorecard selectors
    When the procedure task and living report are rendered
    Then both surfaces identify the run as scorecard-scoped
    And neither surface describes the run as account-wide

  Scenario: An account-wide portfolio run is displayed
    Given an optimization portfolio procedure has no scorecard selectors
    When the procedure task and living report are rendered
    Then both surfaces identify the run as account-wide

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Acceptance: a production-backed read-only portfolio run retained a scorecard-scoped identity consistently in the Report title, adopted Procedure Task description, and embedded summary. Focused Python and dashboard tests passed; no schema or backend resource changed. Committed as d8a2de1d1.
